title: add-oauth-invalid-scope-error
request: Hey, could you add an OAuthInvalidScopeError exception in the client auth exceptions module? I need a specific error class for bad scopes.
reference_diff:
--- a/src/mcp/client/auth/exceptions.py
+++ b/src/mcp/client/auth/exceptions.py
@@ -8,3 +8,6 @@
 
 class OAuthRegistrationError(OAuthFlowError):
     """Raised when client registration fails."""
+
+class OAuthInvalidScopeError(OAuthFlowError):
+    """Raised when an OAuth scope is invalid."""
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/client/auth/extensions/test_invalid_scope_error.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+import pytest
+from mcp.client.auth.exceptions import OAuthInvalidScopeError, OAuthFlowError
+
+def test_invalid_scope_error_is_subclass_of_oauth_flow_error():
+    assert issubclass(OAuthInvalidScopeError, OAuthFlowError)
